manifest.title: Polish documents (without changing what they say)
manifest.description: Polishes the existing documents in a repository or folder one by one, to your style (STYLE.md and chaff.yaml). What they say does not change: the headings, the numbering of articles and sections, code blocks and link targets are checked by machine to be unchanged, and the originals are kept.

targets.label: The documents to polish (one file or folder per line, as a place inside this folder)
targets.why: The candidates are chosen from these

style.label: Which style should they follow?
style.why: If this folder has the STYLE.md and chaff.yaml that "Make a style" wrote, the documents follow them

kind.label: What kind of documents are they?
kind.why: chaff measures each kind with its own yardstick (how long a sentence may be, how much bold is too much, and so on)

options.会社のサイトの記事（オウンドメディア）: An article on a company site
options.演説・挨拶の原稿: Speech or address (to be read aloud)
options.書き起こし（会見・会議での発言の記録）: Transcript (what was said at a press conference or meeting)

scope.label: How far should it fix?
scope.why: Only what the machine found, or also the rules in the guide (tone, spelling and so on)

shelved.label: Fix the shelved findings too?
shelved.why: Findings shelved by "Bring chaff into a document folder" are normally kept quiet. Fixing them shrinks what is left, a little at a time

maxFiles.label: The most files to polish this time
maxFiles.why: Keeps one run to a size; the rest wait for the next run

avoid.label: Files or places to leave alone

survey.title: Choose the documents to polish
survey.description: Measures the documents with chaff and lists the ones worth polishing.

polish.title: Polish them one by one
polish.description: Polishes the listed documents one at a time. Keeps each original, and checks that what it says (headings, numbering, code, link targets) is unchanged and that chaff finds nothing against the style. Repeats while any are left.

report.title: Report
report.description: What was polished, what was checked, and what was left as it was.

oshirase.title: Polish a company notice
oshirase.description: In the sample notice (oshirase.md), fixes what chaff finds (such as an intensifier that says nothing) so it reads easily, without changing what it says. The original is kept. Run the "Make a style" example in the same folder first and choose its style, and the notice follows that style.

houkoku.title: Polish a report as a report
houkoku.description: Reads the sample monthly report (houkoku.md) as a report: whether the conclusion comes first, and whether each request says who does it and by when. Where something needs adding, it is not written in; it is listed in the report as a question for the author. The original is kept.

blog.title: Polish a blog post as a blog post
blog.description: Reads the sample technical blog post (blog.md) as a technical article. An opening that would fit any post is cut; a stock closing line or a closing that only summarises becomes a question for the author. No facts are added. The original is kept.

tejun.title: Polish a procedure as a procedure
tejun.description: Reads the sample procedure (tejun.md) as a manual. What chaff finds (such as a "here" link that does not say where it goes) is fixed without changing what it says. It looks at what you need before starting, whether one step holds two actions, and how to tell a step worked; where something needs adding, it becomes a question for the author in the report. The original is kept.

shayo.title: Polish a regulation as a regulation
shayo.description: Reads the sample company regulation (kitei.md) as a regulation. Emphasis with nothing behind it is fixed without changing what it says. It looks at who a rule applies to, whether a duty has a deadline, what happens when it is not kept, and whether exceptions sit next to their rule; where something needs adding, it becomes a question for the author in the report. The original is kept.

english-blog.title: Polish an English blog post
english-blog.description: Reads the sample English technical blog post (post.md) as a technical article. The post stays in English: an opening that would fit any post or a stock closing line is cut. Where something needs adding, such as a closing that only summarises, it becomes a question for the author in the report. The report comes back in your report language. The original is kept.
